items.title: Lawn mowing & garden maintenance
items.description: Mowing, edging, weeding and hedge trimming — one-off, or on a weekly or fortnightly schedule with no lock-in contract.
items.longDescription: Lawns mown and edged along every path, driveway and bed line. Beds weeded, hedges and shrubs trimmed back to shape, hard surfaces blown down, and green waste taken away with us rather than left in a pile on the nature strip. Book it as a one-off garden tidy-up, or set a weekly or fortnightly run through the growing season and drop back to monthly over winter. No lock-in contract either way — pause or stop whenever you like.

items.title: Pressure washing
items.description: Driveways, paths, patios and pavers cleaned back — before a sale, or after a long winter.
items.longDescription: Concrete driveways, paths, patios, pavers and retaining walls washed back to the surface underneath. Most commonly booked as part of a pre-sale clean-up, or as a reset after winter when moss and algae have taken hold on the shaded side of the house. All equipment and water pressure supplied; we work out the right pressure for the surface rather than blasting everything at maximum.
items.imageAlt: A pressure washer lance cleaning a concrete driveway, leaving a clean strip beside the dirty surface.

items.title: Gutter cleaning
items.description: Single-storey homes. Gutters cleared by hand and downpipes checked to flow.
items.longDescription: Gutters cleared of leaf litter and debris by hand, downpipes checked to confirm they actually run clear, and everything we pull out taken away with us. Worth booking before the first heavy autumn rain and again after leaf drop, especially on the eastern-suburbs blocks with gums or established street trees nearby. Single-storey homes only — we do not carry the roof-access equipment for double-storey work.

story.heading: One person. Done properly.
story.body: GreenEdge is one operator with a trailer, working out of Newton since 2025. We look after lawns, gardens, hard surfaces and gutters across Adelaide's eastern suburbs. Three services, done properly, rather than a list of twenty done badly — no landscaping design, no paving, no tree removal, no irrigation. If a job falls outside that, we will say so on the spot and point you to someone who does it.

process.title: You call or send the form
process.description: Tell us the suburb, the service and roughly what you are dealing with. A photo helps. We answer between 7am and 5pm, Monday to Saturday.

process.title: We quote on site, for free
process.description: We come and look at the actual job rather than guessing off a description. The quote is written down before anything starts.

process.title: We book a time that suits
process.description: Usually within the week for a one-off. Regular schedules get a fixed day so you know when to expect us.

process.title: We do the work and clean up
process.description: Green waste goes on the trailer. Hard surfaces get blown down. You get an invoice for the number you were quoted.

items.question: How much does lawn mowing cost in Adelaide's eastern suburbs?
items.answer: For a standard suburban block in Newton, Campbelltown or Norwood, expect from around $65 a visit for mowing, edging and a blow-down. Larger blocks, overgrown lawns and first cuts cost more. We quote on site so the number is fixed before we start, not estimated over the phone.

items.question: Which suburbs do you cover?
items.answer: Newton, Campbelltown, Athelstone, Paradise, Rostrevor, Tranmere, Hectorville, Felixstow, Magill, Norwood, Payneham, St Peters, Kensington, Burnside and the surrounding eastern suburbs. There is no travel fee within about 15 km of Newton.

items.question: Is there a lock-in contract for regular mowing?
items.answer: No. Weekly, fortnightly, monthly or one-off — you can change the schedule, pause it over winter or stop entirely with no notice period and no cancellation fee.

items.question: Do you take the green waste away?
items.answer: Yes. Clippings, prunings and gutter debris go on the trailer and leave with us. Your green bin stays empty and nothing gets left on the nature strip.

items.question: Do you clean gutters on double-storey homes?
items.answer: No. Single-storey homes only. Double-storey gutter work needs roof-access equipment and a height-safety setup we do not carry, so we would rather say no than do it badly.

items.question: How much does it cost to pressure wash a driveway?
items.answer: From around $250 for a standard concrete driveway in the eastern suburbs. Heavy staining, oil, or years of moss on a shaded surface take longer and cost more. We quote after seeing the surface.

items.question: Do you do landscaping, paving or tree removal?
items.answer: No. We do lawn mowing and garden maintenance, pressure washing, and gutter cleaning. Landscaping design, paving, tree removal and irrigation are outside what we do — if you need one of those, we will tell you on the spot.

items.question: Are you insured?
items.answer: Yes. Public liability cover is in place. ABN 87 823 119 154. Happy to send the certificate of currency through before we start if you want it on file.

items.question: How quickly can you come out?
items.answer: Usually within the week for a one-off, and often sooner for a straightforward mow. Free quotes are generally booked within a day or two. We work Monday to Saturday, 7am to 5pm.

items.question: Do I need to be home?
items.answer: Not for mowing or pressure washing, as long as we have side access and the gate is unlocked. For the first visit and for gutter work it helps to have someone there so we can walk the job together.
